keyFindings: P0: neither badge ever renders on host 0.2.0-rc.2 — projection registration uses schema/view while the host reads stateSchema/wire, so the client view is never produced (badgeCount 0 across every sample).
Fold and persistence are correct: the projection cache holds a sessionCost row with priced=true; only the client view is dropped.
P1: host default model id deepseek-flash is absent from the price table, so it silently falls back to the v4-pro default row: 1M in + 1M out computes $2.61 vs the official off-peak $0.75 (~3.48x).
P2: a 1-token turn formats as $0.00000, indistinguishable from a free turn.
Install is rejected by default (peerDependencies ^0.1.0-rc.6 vs host 0.2.0-rc.2); needs allow-version --accept-risk.

nearMisses.why: context-token measurement batch, not cost display

cleanup.strayFileRemoved: C:\Users\USER\.dsh\cost-pricing.json (written by my own probe; verified by creation time; copy kept in evidence/)

selfCorrections: make-sessions.mjs sessionTotal accumulated the wrong keys (printed 0); fixed to sum u.input/u.output/u.cacheRead/u.cacheWrite.
Synthetic sessions were rejected as corrupt until request/header gained data.reason (initial|change) and non-empty provider/model.
probe-06 first run omitted DSH_HOME and let the plugin write default pricing into the real user home; removed after timestamp verification, DSH_COST_PRICING pinned for all later runs.
notes: All amounts are computed from a price table against synthetic token counts; no model was called, so they are not a bill.
Hover behaviour, badge layout at narrow widths, and dark-theme readability could not be observed because no badge renders; they are marked untested rather than passed.
